entities.name: Igor Mirović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Igor Mirović is a Serbian politician, economist, and poet who served as the president of the Government of Vojvodina from 2016 to 2024. A member of the Serbian Progressive Party, he previously served as the minister of regional development and local self-government from 2013 and 2014.
